name: plan-tracker
description: MCP server for long-term plan tracking — milestones, daily check-ins, webhook push notifications, event-scheduled reminders, and AI-assisted progress analysis. OpenClaw plugin.
author: hinayoung23

scripts.postinstall: echo '[plan-tracker] Installing Python package...' && python3 -m pip install --quiet -e . 2>/dev/null || python3 -m pip install --quiet . && echo '[plan-tracker] Running setup...' && python3 -m plan_tracker.cli setup
